observed_vs_expected: Expected peak scores at half-wave resonance were transiently met, reaching 0.773 in round 3 of the history. However, round 6 recorded a sharp downward deviation to 0.4669 (magnitude ~0.306 loss). Tightest margin observed was 0.2457, failing to tighten as expected under sufficient mirror pair loading. The hypothesized steady alignment with the 1530-1565 nm band is currently compromised by the late-stage score collapse.
deviation_mechanism: The score collapse stems from optical path length (OPL) drift breaking the Fabry-Pérot resonance condition. The optimizer permitted the central defect layer (index 10) to shrink from the verified resonant ~518–529 nm range down to 483 nm. Because resonance requires n_defect * d ≈ λ/2, this 30+ nm reduction detunes the cavity mode away from 1550 nm, spilling energy into the rejected bands. Simultaneously, adjacent high-index quarter-wave layers expanded beyond target widths (~250 nm), widening the photonic bandgap but misaligning the intra-cavity standing wave, producing the measurable 0.30-point penalty.
continue_rationale: The route has executed 6 rounds without exhausting its scientific utility. While scores plateaued near 0.761–0.765 (rounds 4–5), the subsequent plunge to 0.4669 in round 6 confirms the system remains physically feasible but dynamically unstable; the search algorithm drifted into a non-resonant parameter subspace rather than hitting a performance floor. Resetting the cavity thickness initialization to previously validated resonant bounds will recover the ~0.77 baseline, providing clear marginal gain over stagnation.
insight_for_next: Constrain defect layer (index 10) initialization to a uniform prior spanning 515–530 nm for the next batch. Freeze adjacent high/low-index layer updates to ±5% of their quarter-wave targets for two rounds to stabilize the photonic band edges before re-enabling full parameter sweeps.
insight_grounding: Direct audit of the candidate set shows defect thickness (layer 10) ranges 483.18–528.84 nm. Historical peaks anchored tightly to the 518.30–528.84 nm sub-band (corresponding to scores ≥0.761), whereas the lowest recorded value (483.18 nm) coincides with the degraded optical coupling. Constraining initialization to the audited 518.3–528.8 nm window directly targets the measured resonance condition.
